_about: CBorg labels each model in /model/info (model_info.display_name, e.g. 'CBorg Coder
Ultra - Mistral Large 4'), and lil-agent records that label in every run. This file
keeps what the live label can't: which model each backend ran, and when. Keys are
backends (litellm_params.model); many aliases can share one backend. 'history' is
oldest first: 'from' is the date a mapping was first observed; 'display_name' and
'context' (max_input_tokens) are what CBorg reported then. lil-agent warns when the
live label or context differs from the period in effect, which is how a silent
switch shows up. When CBorg changes a model, add a history entry rather than
